implemented: Rebuilds original name and source allocation contracts from the decoded record using the existing recovered contract producer and requires exact agreement with the prepared contracts.
Requires exactly one caller-supplied byte array of the correct size per recovered name and complete one-to-one coverage of the installed shader loose allocations.

Uses converted ParameterMap buffer indices and byte allocations, verifies installed shader platform, frequency, binding layout and RHI compiled output hash, and checks everything before changing draw bindings.
Provides separate preparation and non-failing application so callers can validate loose values before other draw-binding writes.
Uses exact-size 4, 8, 12 and 16 byte value wrappers for the engine's templated Add, avoiding pointer-sized copies and truncation.

engine_contracts.binding: Renderer/Public/MeshDrawShaderBindings.h: FMeshDrawSingleShaderBindings::Add(FShaderParameter, const ParameterType&) locates packed loose data by buffer and base index and copies min(sizeof(ParameterType), parameter size).
engine_contracts.output_identity: RenderCore/Private/ShaderResource.cpp: the inline shader map resource sets the compiled output hash on the RHI shader; FShader::GetOutputHash is editor-only.

verification: Bounded source/API review and diff checks only; no build or runtime verification.
remaining: No pass or provider invokes this bridge.

The caller must supply the actual exact bytes for every recovered parameter, and the corresponding decoded record, prepared contracts and converted output. No producer values or defaults are inferred.
Other mesh resources and uniform buffers require their own bindings.

combined_draw_api.behavior: Checks original record identity, prepares and owns all explicit loose values before calling uniform binding, then applies the validated loose snapshot without a failure path. A rejected loose value cannot leave uniform bindings partially changed.
combined_draw_api.limits: No live pass/provider hookup or producer values. Shader, values, retained RHI references and thread requirements remain those of the underlying APIs.
